_about: Region-neutral change catalogue. Each change maps to an entry in every region pack. kind: cmc, labeling, efficacy or admin (decides the submission type). scope: all, small (chemical drugs), bio, sterile. evidence: ids from evidence.json.

groups.label: Biologics: cell banks, purification, viral safety

changes.title: Move drug product manufacturing to a different site
changes.help: Manufacture or processing of the finished product moves to another site (your own or a contract manufacturer).
changes.keywords: new site transfer contract manufacturer CMO plant relocation finished product

changes.title: Move drug substance manufacturing to a different site
changes.help: The active substance (API) is made at another site, including a new API supplier using the approved process.
changes.keywords: API supplier active substance new manufacturer site drug substance source

changes.title: Move manufacture of a drug substance intermediate
changes.help: An intermediate step of the API synthesis moves to another site.
changes.keywords: intermediate final intermediate synthesis step site

changes.title: Move primary packaging to a different site
changes.help: Packaging into the container that touches the product (bottle, blister) moves to another site.
changes.keywords: packager packaging site blister bottling primary

changes.title: Move secondary packaging to a different site
changes.help: Cartoning or other packaging that does not touch the product moves.

changes.title: Move labeling operations to a different site
changes.help: Applying labels moves to another site.

changes.title: Move release or stability testing to a different laboratory
changes.help: A contract or in-house lab at a different site takes over testing.
changes.keywords: contract lab QC laboratory testing site release testing

changes.title: Move ink imprinting of tablets or capsules to a different site
changes.help: Only the printing step on solid oral dosage forms moves.

changes.title: Change the contract sterilization site for packaging components
changes.help: Stoppers, vials or other components are sterilized by a different contractor.

changes.title: Add a filling line for a sterile product
changes.help: A new or alternative aseptic filling line is used for the product.
changes.keywords: fill line filling aseptic line vial filling

changes.title: Replace equipment with equipment of the same design and operating principle
changes.help: Like-for-like replacement, for example a new blender of the same type.
changes.keywords: equipment replacement like for like same design

changes.title: Change the drug product manufacturing process, parameters or equipment type
changes.help: Process steps, parameters or equipment of a different design change.
changes.keywords: process parameter equipment granulation drying compression coating mixing time

changes.title: Change the batch size (scale up or down)
changes.help: The batch size changes using the approved process.
changes.keywords: batch size scale up scale down

changes.title: Introduce a new route of synthesis for the drug substance
changes.help: A different chemical route makes the API.
changes.keywords: synthesis route chemistry API new route

changes.title: Change the drug substance manufacturing process or parameters
changes.help: Steps, solvents, reagents or parameters of the approved route change.

changes.title: Redefine an intermediate as a starting material
changes.help: An intermediate (not the final one) becomes a registered starting material.

changes.title: Add a reprocessing procedure for batches that fail specification
changes.help: A new procedure to rework out-of-specification batches.

changes.title: Add an ink imprint or change the imprinting ink
changes.help: A printed code is added to tablets or capsules, or the ink changes.

changes.title: Add or delete an embossed, debossed or engraved code
changes.help: A code pressed into the tablet surface is added or removed.
changes.keywords: deboss emboss engrave code tablet marking

changes.title: Change the order of adding ingredients to a solution
changes.help: For solution dosage forms or solutions used in unit operations.

changes.title: Change the sterilizing filtration
changes.help: The sterilizing filter or its operating parameters change.

changes.title: Change the sterilization method
changes.help: For example moving from aseptic filling to terminal sterilization, or dry heat to irradiation.

changes.title: Change a depyrogenation process for components
changes.help: The process that removes endotoxin from glass or other components changes.

changes.title: Remove an in-process filtration that is not the sterilizing filtration
changes.help: An extra filtration step before the sterilizing filter is dropped.

changes.title: Add process controls that give more assurance
changes.help: Methods or controls that increase assurance the product will meet its specification.

changes.title: Change the amount or type of an excipient
changes.help: Quantitative or qualitative change to inactive ingredients.
changes.keywords: excipient formulation composition filler binder lubricant

changes.title: Delete or reduce a colour or flavour
changes.help: A colourant or flavour is removed or reduced.

changes.title: Add a new strength
changes.help: A new strength of the same dosage form.

changes.title: Tighten an acceptance criterion
changes.help: A narrower limit in the drug substance or drug product specification.

changes.title: Relax (widen) an acceptance criterion
changes.help: A wider limit for a test.
changes.keywords: relax widen limit dissolution impurity assay

changes.title: Delete a test from a specification
changes.help: A test is removed.

changes.title: Add a test and acceptance criterion
changes.help: A new test that increases assurance of quality.

changes.title: Change a specification to comply with a compendium
changes.help: Follow a USP–NF (or other pharmacopoeia) revision, without relaxing or deleting.

changes.title: Change a regulatory analytical procedure
changes.help: The approved test method for the drug substance or drug product changes.
changes.keywords: method HPLC analytical procedure potency assay

changes.title: Establish a new regulatory analytical procedure
changes.help: Including making an alternative procedure the regulatory one.

changes.title: Add, revise or delete an alternative analytical procedure
changes.help: A back-up method with the same or better assurance.

changes.title: Change a test method for components, packaging, the final intermediate or in-process materials
changes.help: Methods used for materials other than the drug substance and drug product.
changes.keywords: excipient method packaging component test in-process

changes.title: Change a test method for raw materials used in drug substance synthesis
changes.help: Methods for materials used before the final intermediate.
changes.keywords: raw material method starting material reagent

changes.title: Change the polymeric material of primary packaging for a liquid or semisolid
changes.help: Bottle, tube or bag material that touches a liquid or semisolid product.
changes.keywords: plastic polymer bottle tube liquid semisolid HDPE

changes.title: Change the container for a sterile product
changes.help: For example vial to prefilled syringe, ampoule to vial, single-dose to multiple-dose, or a new size or shape.
changes.keywords: vial syringe ampoule prefilled container sterile

changes.title: Change packaging that controls the dose delivered
changes.help: For example a metered-dose valve, actuator or pen mechanism.
changes.keywords: valve actuator inhaler device pen dose

changes.title: Change the closure or packaging of a solid oral product
changes.help: Caps, liners, seals, child-resistant closures, plastic type.
changes.keywords: cap closure child-resistant liner seal bottle tablets

changes.title: Change the closure of a non-sterile liquid
changes.help: Caps, liners, seals or a thicker container wall.

changes.title: Change the size or shape of a container
changes.help: Same material and closure, different size or shape.

changes.title: Change the number of units or the labeled amount in a container
changes.help: For example 30 to 90 tablets per bottle.
changes.keywords: count pack size fill quantity units

changes.title: Add, change or delete a desiccant
changes.help: A desiccant canister or sachet in the pack.

changes.title: Change unit-dose (blister) packaging of a non-sterile solid
changes.help: New blister film or foil.
changes.keywords: blister foil PVC PVDC unit dose

changes.title: Delete protective secondary packaging
changes.help: Removing an overwrap or carton that protects the product (for example from light or moisture).

changes.title: Change the colour of a flip-seal cap
changes.help: Colour only, consistent with any colour-coding system.

changes.title: Extend the shelf life (expiration dating period)
changes.help: A longer shelf life based on stability data.
changes.keywords: shelf life expiry extension expiration dating

changes.title: Reduce the shelf life
changes.help: A shorter shelf life to give more assurance of quality.

changes.title: Change the approved stability protocol
changes.help: Time points, tests, conditions or acceptance criteria in the post-approval stability protocol.

changes.title: Change the labeled storage conditions
changes.help: For example from refrigerated to room temperature.

changes.title: Replace an in-house reference standard
changes.help: A new lot of the in-house primary or working standard, qualified under the approved protocol.

changes.title: Add a new indication
changes.help: A new use supported by clinical studies.

changes.title: Expand or narrow the population, or change dosing, based on new data
changes.help: For example adding a paediatric age group.

changes.title: Update clinical pharmacology or clinical studies sections with new data
changes.help: New or changed study data in the label.
changes.keywords: clinical pharmacology clinical studies section data

changes.title: Add or strengthen a warning, precaution, contraindication or adverse reaction
changes.help: Safety information the company adds on its own initiative.
changes.keywords: adverse reaction warning precaution contraindication safety signal

changes.title: Add or strengthen an instruction about dosage and administration for safer use
changes.help: Clearer administration instructions intended to increase safe use.

changes.title: Delete false, misleading or unsupported information
changes.help: For example an indication or claim no longer supported.

changes.title: Implement safety labeling requested by the agency
changes.help: The agency asks for new safety information in the labeling: in the US an FDA notification under section 505(o)(4); in the EU an assessed outcome such as a PRAC signal recommendation.
changes.keywords: 505(o)(4) safety labeling change notification FDA required PRAC signal PSUSA agreed wording

changes.title: Update generic labeling to match the reference product
changes.help: The reference (brand) product's labeling changed; the generic, hybrid or biosimilar follows it.
changes.keywords: RLD reference listed drug generic labeling update

changes.title: Make an editorial labeling change
changes.help: For example adding a distributor's name or fixing a typo.

changes.title: Change the layout of a package or container label (no change to the SmPC)
changes.help: Layout only, no change in content.

changes.title: Submit a comparability protocol (PACMP)
changes.help: A plan for a future change, with studies and acceptance criteria, that asks for a lower reporting category.

changes.title: Make a change under an approved comparability protocol
changes.help: The change and its data follow the approved protocol.

changes.title: Any change that needs a new bioequivalence study
changes.help: Changes where in vivo bioequivalence must be shown again.

changes.title: Establish a new master cell bank
changes.help: A new master cell bank or master virus seed.

changes.title: Establish a new working cell bank
changes.help: A new working cell bank from the approved master cell bank.

changes.title: Change a purification step
changes.help: New resin, column, step or loading, or a change in parameters.

changes.title: Change a virus removal or inactivation step
changes.help: Viral clearance steps such as nanofiltration or low-pH hold.

changes.title: Transfer the application to a new owner
changes.help: The application is sold or transferred to another company.

changes.title: Change the applicant's name or address
changes.help: The company changes its name or moves its registered address, with no change in ownership.
